text:
mina-cs: Heads-up — Sheridan Health pilot tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Dry-run showed p95 spikes in APAC and CA. They asked for a regional allowlist + short rate uplift for ap-southeast-1 and ca-central-1. Renewal review in 16 days; execs are watching.
colin-ops: OK. Please paste CIDRs, expected peak QPS, partner vendors, and whether they want routing pinned.
mina-cs: Sheridan sent `203.0.119.21/32` and partner Vizlytics `203.0.120.0/24`. Expect bursts to ~1100 qps for 20-25m, steady ~180 qps. They want pinned routing to avoid cross-region tail latency.
sera-net: Proposed: AL-SH-2026 allowlist + TEMP_PEAK_8H policy max_qps=1400, burst 30m. TTL 8h auto-revoke. Pin to ap-southeast-1 & ca-central-1 and pre-warm KV/embeddings. Need security sign-off for partner CIDR.
yvonne-sec: Security: require AUP + vendor attestation in ticket CS-17456. Prefer mTLS for Vizlytics; if not available require cert rotation within 48h and scoped tokens. 8h TTL is fine with audit logging.
jules-ae: I'll flag renewal watch with the account execs and prepare an executive summary. Recommend a 15m runbook call 45m before demo with their infra lead.
mina-cs: Sheridan infra lead is marta@sheridan.health — I've looped her in. She confirmed CIDRs and said they can push ~1.2k qps for a short window.
colin-ops: Plan to create allowlist `AL-SH-2026` and rate policy `TEMP_PEAK_8H`. I'll schedule at 07:15 UTC to warm caches. Command (applies at scheduled time):
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-SH-2026","cidrs":["203.0.119.21/32","203.0.120.0/24"],"ttl":"8h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_PEAK_8H","max_qps":1400,"burst_window_sec":1800,"regions":["ap-southeast-1","ca-central-1"]}
```
scheduler-bot: allowlist AL-SH-2026 scheduled at 2026-09-03T07:15:00Z by colin-ops
sera-net: LGTM. I'll kick KV warm and preload frequent prompt prefixes after apply.
yvonne-sec: Approve conditioned on AUP and Vizlytics attestation in CS-17456. If we see anomalous patterns (sustained >2x expected) we revoke immediately.
colin-ops: Applied and pinned routing. Monitoring during warm shows connections healthy and no error spikes.
mina-cs: Demo complete — sustained peak ~1.05k qps for ~14m. p95 dropped from ~420ms -> 65ms in ap-southeast; ca-central p95 down to 90ms after warm. Vizlytics asked for a 3h ephemeral add for `203.0.121.0/24` to finish a backfill. Can we approve?
yvonne-sec: 3h ephemeral OK if Vizlytics posts attestation and uses scoped tokens. Manual approval + audit log required. I'll sign off in ticket once posted.
colin-ops: Adding `203.0.121.0/24` TTL 3h, auto-revoke scheduled. AL-SH-2026 updated. Monitoring shows stable connections and no auth anomalies.
jules-ae: Demo success — execs pleased. Renewal moved from watch -> green/monitor. Mina, please send a short NPS + latency pulse and attach the runbook notes to CS-17456.
mina-cs: Will do. Thanks team! :tada:
